purpose: Hermes pre-upgrade baseline snapshot. Captures the official NousResearch upstream identity, the historical observed live runtime identity (Xiaomi Mimo), the local Paperclip hermes_local adapter compatibility patches, the provider registry and profiles currently in use, and the fresh-readback requirements that gate any later upgrade. Side-effect-free: read-only, no network calls to live Paperclip, no docker mutation, no secret capture.

trigger_conditions: any NousResearch hermes-agent PyPI release past 0.18.2
any new runtime evidence past the 2026-06-04 failure window
any new GSD memory entry tagged Hermes or NousResearch
any change to /paperclip/hermes-runtime on the live VPS without going through the hermes-rollback path
any change to the XIAOMI_API_KEY / XIAOMI_BASE_URL or PAPERCLIP adapterConfig.hermesLocal block
any new doc on the Paperclip process adapter for hermes_local that changes the CLI invocation contract

official_upstream_identity.policy: Verified by independent remote readback of the canonical upstream repository and PyPI project page. No interaction with the live VPS or paperclip.oysana.com runtime.
official_upstream_identity.fresh_readback_via: PyPI simple API or GitHub releases page

local_paperclip_checkout.policy: Hermes is NOT vendored into this repository. The Paperclip container consumes hermes-agent from PyPI at runtime under /paperclip/hermes-runtime/. There is no local Hermes fork or mirror in the working tree.

provider_registry_observed.policy: Provider registry as observed in the LAST Paperclip adapterConfig for hermes_local. Captured here as HISTORICAL OBSERVATION ONLY. The current registry carries one PRIMARY provider (xiaomi/mimo) and one fallback provider (openai-codex/gpt-5.3-codex).

local_paperclip_adapter_compatibility_pa.policy: Local Paperclip adapter-layer compatibility patches that allow the upstream hermes-agent CLI to be invoked under Paperclip. These patches live in the Paperclip image, not in this repo, but they ARE required for hermes_local to function and MUST be re-verified after any upgrade.
local_paperclip_adapter_compatibility_pa.fresh_readback_via: Read of /paperclip/hermes-runtime/bin/hermes-paperclip + Paperclip process adapter source diff

patches_observed.summary: Wrapper at /paperclip/hermes-runtime/bin/hermes-paperclip exports PYTHONUSERBASE=/paperclip/hermes-runtime and re-invokes the upstream hermes CLI from the userbase.

First-time install used pip --break-system-packages against /paperclip/hermes-runtime because Debian Python is externally managed. This override must NOT be re-applied at upgrade time unless explicitly approved.

Paperclip process adapter for hermes_local calls hermes-paperclip with provider/model/timeoutSec/graceSec in adapterConfig. Output is captured as stdout/stderr excerpts and as session id; resultJson.bos must be produced by the upstream hermes CLI itself.

XIAOMI_API_KEY and XIAOMI_BASE_URL are passed through Paperclip secret_ref envelope; the adapter never sees the resolved values in the rendered adapterConfig. Migration to MiniMax M3 must keep the same secret_ref envelope shape.

rollout_safety_constraints.policy: Constraints inherited from S01-S04 that any Hermes upgrade must honor. S05 must NOT relax any of these without an explicit decision in M014 DECISIONS.

inherited_constraints.summary: Prefer Paperclip HTTP/admin routes; never patch Paperclip core source.
Live mutation requires explicit authenticated operator confirmation with PAPERCLIP_COMPANY_ID_OVERRIDE=allow and visible target company.
Forbidden commands (docker compose down -v, prune, rm, volume rm) unless explicitly approved for destructive recovery.
VPS forensics verdict is H-INCONCLUSIVE; no destructive recovery is approved; only safe-restart command allowed.
Safe restart command MUST be the one in paperclip-runtime.lock.json safe_restart_command and nothing else.
Stale ID ledger from R3 must not appear as canonical company_id in any Hermes-driven mutation.
